scenario: [LNLS.3.3]'s exemption: a negated pattern whose `where` references no earlier binding asks only whether a matching fact exists, so it needs no anchor. `no R x where x.amount > 5` is decided per `R` fact on its own; when the answer changes, every token it blocks or releases is part of the result. PATH PINNED: `dsc.validate.lnls_3_3_anchors`, the exemption for a `no` pattern with no cross-pattern reference; dropping it turns this red with DS_VALIDATE_NOLINSCAN_JOIN_ANCHOR_C. The `D` pattern carries no binding ([LGRA.8.6]): a named but unread one is refused first, by another check, and would mask this one.
rules_ds:
use default:
    linear_scan: false

schema D scope logical:
    id: String key
    level: Int mutable

schema R scope logical:
    id: String key
    amount: Int mutable

rule r:
    D
    no R x where x.amount > 5
->
    log info "x"
